name: National Highways Infra Trust
about: NHAI is the nodal agency responsible for the development and maintenance of national highways. It was constituted u/s 3(1) of the National Highways Authority of India Act, 1988, and commenced operations in February 1995 to develop, maintain, and manage national highways in the country. The NHAI is vested with executive powers for developing national highways in India by MoRTH. The charter of NHAI is set out in the National Highways Act, 1956, and the National Highways Authority of India Act,1988. The GoI has a 100% stake in NHAI.[1]
